verdict.rationale: Twilio documents its own Phone Numbers APIs for searching and buying numbers, plus Regulatory Compliance APIs for creating Regulatory Bundles, which implies country regulatory requirements are handled. The pack never shows which countries are available or that each country's documentation requirements are stated up front, and one community report describes difficulty getting German numbers. missing for 10: evidence of multi-country number coverage, per-country documentation requirements disclosed before purchase, independent hands-on corroboration of international provisioning.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front

citations.quote: With the Phone Numbers APIs, you can search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, manage your Twilio numbers, port a phone number you own to Twilio
shows how to create a Regulatory Bundle with the v2 Regulatory Compliance (RC) REST APIs.
